name: Finite Automata
description: Runs a finite automaton diagram (type/ fa) on a tape: step by step with the marks on the diagram, the verdict and the output, or over a tests file. Needs the fa-dispatcher-py modules with CyberiadaML in the Python the plugin runs with.

parameters.label: Tests file
parameters.description: A tape per line: + accepted, - rejected, => the expected output

actions.label: Test the Tapes...
actions.description: Run the tapes of a tests file; a failing tape is a finding on the state where its run stopped

actions.label: Run on a Tape
actions.description: Run the automaton on a tape one symbol at a time; the editor marks the active state and the fired transition and shows the verdict and the output
